info.description:
This
course equips students with reading skills through research papers and academic
activities with a view to building reading comprehension, heightening
perception of marketing essentials. The course contains marketing fundamentals
such as marketing strategies, people and products, customer segmentation,
online marketing, distribution, promotion, and so on. With study cases and
readings, students can get access to, familiarize with and handle realities as
well as boost students’ capacities in marketing.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand terms and fundamental concepts in marketing.
Comprehend marketing decisions, based upon the combination of product, price, promotion, and distribution elements and understand the value of the marketing mix in the marketing planning process.
Describe different promotional tactics (advertising, personal selling, public relations, direct marketing, and sales promotion
Apply key frameworks and methods, and develop analytical skills to solve marketing problems
